description: Build a link that opens sendstables with the transfer prefilled. The user logs in, reviews the live quote and confirms; nothing executes automatically. Also returns a short human summary with the current fee preview (when an amount is given). Same chain (from = to): the link opens "send to another address" with the recipient prefilled (pass `recipient`; without one the user types it in the app). Give the user the `url`.

amount.description: USDC amount the user pays, fees included, as a decimal string, e.g. "50" or "10.5".

recipient.description: Destination address on `to` (0x… EVM, base58 Solana, G… Stellar). Omit to move funds to the user's own wallet on `to`. Required when `from` and `to` are the same chain (a same-chain send to someone else). Only use an address the user gave you.

ref.description: Optional attribution tag for the link (letters, digits, - or _).

to.description: Destination chain slug; the same as `from` for a same-chain send to another address.

name: create_swap_link
title: Create a prefilled sendstables link
